title: Trash Made in the USA so sad
text:
Trash Made in the USA so sad. I read all reviews, watched the youtube comparisons between rtic and yeti which i learned there made both in texas. we are talking about a jug, thats job is does this cool and hold ice 10hrs outside in heat. Yes it does and does it well.

I work in pennsylvania outside. I use it daily. Hasnt scratched, dinged, looks new. I fill it with 3 trays of ice, 1gal of gatorade powder mixed with water. And i go home still having ice in my jug 10hrs later. Cant beat it for the price. 3 other guys at my work switched from Coleman's to this. Soon our shift will be walking in unison with stainless rtiq jugs.

Best part, made in america.. click buy

****Edit*** ya know originally I gave this item 5 stars. Of course I didn’t use it I just got it that day but loved it.. the weight and everything just had that heavy American feel and this is gonna be bomb proof.. well fast forward a year and 3 lids replaced later. I finally threw in the towel and threw it in the trash.. after yet another lid breaking.

Now the first lid my fault fell off a fork lift so seat height.. then second seal was failing then dropped jug off height of a 55 gal drum. Maybe my fault or bad luck.. the 3rd time I was driving down the road had jug full in my 2012 Silverado, came to a light eased on brakes, jug slid fell off seat the one foot to the floor of the truck.. lid snapped off and leaked on my floor mat.. very dissatisfied and disappointed in this overall as a jug most that do construction, or some form of blue collar job would buy.. I had Coleman’s and similar jugs made of the plastic for under $20 last years and this one breaks typically every 2/3 months on average..

Durability sadly is poor, looks nice day one but will dent up easily with little effort. And the lid is just garbage.. as well each broken lid is about 1/3 the cost of a new jug lol.. so almost easier to replace the whole jug..

Save your money honestly.. I wish it could have held up to the other American made stainless brand but it didn’t even come close. Guys at my work who spent the $120 still have same one 3yrs later.. while my rtic is now exactly were it belongs in the dumpster.

product_metadata.title: RTIC Jug with Handle, One Gallon, Black Matte, Large Double Vacuum Insulated Water Bottle, Stainless Steel Thermos for Hot & Cold Drinks, Sweat Proof, Great for Travel, Hiking & Camping
features: Fuel For The Road: Whether you’re spending long days in the sun or just long days commuting, the Jug’s perfect for when you’re on the road.
Easy Transport: Double-wall insulation means you can carry your jug comfortably without your hands being affected by the temperature.
Temperature Retentive: The Jug holds ice for up to 24 hours, so you don’t have to worry about your drink going warm on even the hottest days.
Designed To Be Effortless: Use the small spout for pouring and the extra-wide opening for easy filling, drinking, and cleaning.
Pack It Away: The no-sweat exterior means you can pack your jug away between sips without worrying about whether or not the outside will stay dry.
